name: SEVEN SCHOOL GHOST STORIES | 学校の七つの怪談

reviews.review_description:
If you spot an anomaly, go up. If not, go down. You have to go up to the rooftop using this really simple rule.
I thought I'm dull to horror game, but I realized that wandering alone in the dark corners of a closed school in search of the anomaly could set such psychological pressure on me.
Considering price, the graphics and performance are great.
